0022600206.text: The Grizzlies (6-3) come in on a three-game losing streak, though they are 4-0 on the road, and they sit 7th in the West and 3rd in the Southwest, 1 game back. The Raptors (5-4) have won their last game, are 6th in the East and 4th in the Atlantic, 2.5 games back, and Memphis will be without Isaiah Stewart (knee bruise), Richie Saunders (knee surgery), and Scotty Pippen Jr. (back soreness). Toronto is missing Kawhi Leonard (knee inflammation) and Nate Bittle (foot fracture), while Immanuel Quickley (hamstring) and Scottie Barnes (groin soreness) are day-to-day with game-time decisions. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Grizzlies lost 0-2 to the Raptors in the 2025-26 season series, including a 128-96 loss in Memphis on April 3, 2026.
